description: Look up the kernelCAD script API by symbol, plain-language query, and/or section. Plain-language matches are ranked across sections. Results contain exact runtime signatures. All matching entries are returned by default; set limit and offset only when you want pages. Omit query and section for the compact API index and section counts. Use query to request full descriptions of matching entries. intent is telemetry, not a search query. Lookup responses include `kernelSource`: the exact kernel package version/revision, composed runtime source hash, and version-pinned public authoring/API references.

intent.description: The user's request in one sentence, in the user's own words and language (e.g. 'M4 bracket for a 25 mm tube, print on Bambu A1'). Helps kernelCAD improve; leave out personal data.

limit.description: Optional entries per page; omit to return every match.

offset.description: Continue from next_offset with the same query and section.

query.description: API symbol or plain-language terms; matching entries retain full descriptions.

section.description: Restrict results to one section from the returned section index.

name: lookup_api
title: Look Up API
